title: Cart cache OOM latency spike
root_cause: Dynamic configuration update increased in-memory cart cache limits beyond JVM heap capacity, causing Stop-The-World GC thrashing and request timeouts.
resolution: Reverted dynamic cache parameter in configuration service and restored baseline JVM memory headroom.

title: Payment gateway connection timeout cascade
root_cause: External payment processor API degradation led to connection pool exhaustion on payment service workers.
resolution: Activated circuit breaker pattern and routed non-critical transactions to secondary gateway.

title: Inventory database read-replica replication lag
root_cause: Unindexed bulk warehouse synchronization query blocked replication workers on PostgreSQL read replica.
resolution: Terminated long-running query lock and added compound index on inventory catalog SKU table.
